name: Kalambaka (Town Centre)
tagline: Main town beneath the towering rock pillars
description: Kalambaka is the largest town at the foot of the Meteora rocks, holding most hotels, tavernas, supermarkets, banks and the train and bus stations. Streets fan out from the central square toward the sandstone cliffs and monasteries above.
bestFor: Travellers wanting full amenities, transport links and easy monastery access

name: Kastraki
tagline: Quiet stone village under the cliffs
description: Kastraki is a smaller traditional village sitting even closer to the rock formations than Kalambaka. Its narrow lanes, stone houses and guesthouses attract climbers and hikers, with trails to the monasteries starting nearby and dramatic pillar views everywhere.
bestFor: Hikers, climbers and travellers wanting a calmer village base

name: Kalambaka Upper Town (Old Quarter)
tagline: Historic lanes near the old church
description: The upper part of Kalambaka climbs toward the cliffs and holds the old quarter around the Byzantine Church of the Dormition of the Virgin. Older stone houses, quieter streets and closer footpath access to the monasteries define this area.
bestFor: Visitors wanting old-town character and shorter walks to trailheads
